name: elizaos-plugin-agent402
description: elizaOS plugin for Agent402: find and call pay-per-call web tools (search, page render, PDFs, market and SEC data), paid in USDC over x402 from an EVM wallet or by prepaid card credits, with per-call and daily spend ceilings; the pure-CPU tools are free via proof-of-work. Agentic Finance for elizaOS agents.
author: Havok Holdings LLC

AGENT402_CREDITS_KEY.description: Prepaid card-credits key (a402_...) from https://agent402.tools/credits. Pays wallet-only tools by card.

AGENT402_WALLET_KEY.description: EVM private key holding USDC on Base; pays wallet-only tools over x402 (needs @x402/fetch, @x402/evm, viem installed).

AGENT402_BASE_URL.description: Gateway base URL (self-hosters point this at their own instance).

AGENT402_MAX_PER_CALL_USD.description: Ceiling on a single paid call in USD; a call priced above it is refused before paying.

AGENT402_DAILY_LIMIT_USD.description: Ceiling on rolling 24-hour paid spend in USD, kept across calls for the runtime's lifetime.

AGENT402_MAX_RESULT_CHARS.description: Optional bound on a tool result's JSON length in the model context. Unset (default): the complete result is always placed in the action text. Set: a larger result is an explicit failure (errorCode result_too_large) carrying the whole result in data.result, never a truncated text.
